slides.headline: 2026: An Indian-origin engineer is about to run Adobe for the second time in a row.
Anil Chakravarthy named Adobe's next President and CEO
slides.body: Adobe's board has named Chakravarthy - a B.Tech graduate of IIT (BHU) Varanasi who moved to the US at 21 for MIT - as the company's next President and CEO. He succeeds Shantanu Narayen, himself Indian-origin, who becomes Executive Chair. The handoff, announced September 3, 2026, takes effect December 1, 2026.

slides.headline: A $1 billion business unit, two major acquisitions, and a company guiding toward $26 billion in revenue.
slides.body: Chakravarthy joined Adobe in 2020, built its Customer Experience business past $1 billion in quarterly revenue, and led the acquisitions of Workfront and Semrush. He'll now steer a company with roughly 31,000 employees worldwide - with Narayen's own nearly two-decade run at the top making this the second consecutive Indian-origin CEO at Adobe.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: One IIT campus, two Adobe CEOs, one relay baton.
slides.body: As India's engineering pipeline keeps feeding the world's largest software companies, Viksit Bharat 2047 isn't just about what India builds at home - it's about the systems India-trained minds now run everywhere.
